actualDwgCli.probeSource:
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/dli/dev/libdxfrw/tools')
from bounded_process import run_bounded

root = Path('/private/tmp/libdxfrw-target-transport.GsJ7UV')
source = root / 'authored-unicode.dwg'
converter = Path('/Users/dli/dev/libdxfrw/build/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf')
verifier = Path('/Users/dli/dev/libdxfrw/build/libdxfrw_gbk_codepage_tests')
source_hash = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert source.read_bytes()[:6] == b'AC1027'
rows = []
for freecad in (False, True):
    for binary in (False, True):
        output = root / f'dwg-target-{freecad}-{binary}.dxf'
        def command(path, version, input_path=source):
            args = [str(converter), str(input_path)]
            args += ['-o', str(path), version, '-y'] if freecad else [version, '-y', str(path)]
            if binary: args.insert(len(args) if freecad else len(args) - 1, '-b')
            return args
        for existing in (False, True):
            output.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            if existing: output.write_bytes(b'DWG target sentinel\n')
            result = run_bounded(command(output, '-v2004'), 5, 65536, cwd=root)
            assert result.returncode == 1 and b'dxf-text-target-loss' in result.stderr
            assert (output.read_bytes() if output.exists() else None) == (b'DWG target sentinel\n' if existing else None)
            rows.append({'route':'legacy-refusal', 'freecad':freecad, 'binary':binary, 'existing':existing, 'exit':result.returncode})
        result = run_bounded(command(output, '-v2007'), 5, 65536, cwd=root)
        assert result.returncode == 0
        check = run_bounded([str(verifier), '--verify-target-dxf-control', str(output)], 5, 65536, cwd=root)
        assert check.returncode == 0
        second = root / f'dwg-second-{freecad}-{binary}.dxf'
        result2 = run_bounded(command(second, '-v2007', output), 5, 65536, cwd=root)
        assert result2.returncode == 0
        check2 = run_bounded([str(verifier), '--verify-target-dxf-control', str(second)], 5, 65536, cwd=root)
        assert check2.returncode == 0
        rows.append({'route':'modern-two-pass', 'freecad':freecad, 'binary':binary, 'exit':result.returncode,
                     'secondExit':result2.returncode, 'checks':[check.returncode, check2.returncode],
                     'outputSha256':hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                     'secondSha256':hashlib.sha256(second.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == source_hash
print(json.dumps({'sourceSha256':source_hash, 'sourceVersion':'AC1027', 'refusals':8,
                  'modernTwoPassRoutes':4, 'callbackVerifiers':8, 'rows':rows,
                  'scope':'locally authored writer/reader control; no independent producer/native support qualification'}, indent=2))
